integrity: The displayed distribution, moments, covariance formulas, and monotonicity were reconstructed from the ANOVA decomposition and checked algebraically; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact distribution assumes iid Gaussian observations, a fixed balanced fold partition, the sample-mean predictor, and squared loss.
Variance monotonicity compares each K-fold score to its own natural training-size risk target rather than to a common full-sample estimand.
Targeted searches cannot exclude an older equivalent formula under different terminology.
title: Exact Gaussian law and fold-monotone variance of balanced K-fold cross-validation
